## Overview

Explore Xiaomi Mi 3: source-listed display, performance, battery and camera details, followed by practical checks before making a decision. This is a reference guide, not a new-launch report.

## Source-listed specifications

| Field | Source-listed detail |
| --- | --- |
| Introduced | 2013-09-05 |
| Manufacturer | Xiaomi |
| Display | IPS Display 5 inches @ 1920px x 1080px (441 PPI) (Manufactured by Sharp or LG) |
| Processor | 2.3 GHz Qualcomm Snapdragon 800 MSM8274AB/8674AB Quad-Core Krait 400 ( WCDMA / CDMA ) 1.8 GHz Nvidia Tegra 4 4+1 Core Cortex-A15 ( TD-LTE ) |
| Battery | 3050mAh, up to 500hrs standby time, up to 25hrs talk time and up to 50hrs music playback [ 2 ] |

| Cameras | 13 Megapixels (backside-illuminated (BSI)) , with a super-large Sony Exmor sensor and an f/2.2 aperture, built-in Phillips dual-CFL flash. Records 1080p at 30 fps and 720p at 120 fps |
| Connectivity | Bluetooth 4.0 + A2DP , ANT+ , Dual-band Wi-Fi ( 802.11 b / g / n ), Wi-Fi Direct , Wi-Fi Display , Micro- USB On-The-Go with MHL link, DLNA , NFC , GPS + GLONASS , AGPS |
| Os | Original: MIUI V5 ( Android 4.3 Jelly Bean ) Current: MIUI 9 ( Android 4.4 Kitkat for TD-LTE Version) ( Android 6.0 Marshmallow for WCDMA/CDMA Version) |

| Weight | 145 g (5.1 oz) [ 1 ] |

| Removable storage | None |

## How to compare specifications

Check the exact regional model, chipset, screen, battery capacity, charging standards, camera hardware, storage, network bands and promised software updates against manufacturer documentation.

## Price and availability

Prices vary by market, storage option, taxes and date. Confirm the live selling price, warranty, launch status and availability with the manufacturer or authorized retailer.

## Buyer checklist

Check regional warranty, supported networks, return policy, update commitments, accessories and repair availability before purchase.

## Verification and limitations

This profile is based on a source directory record. An empty field means the information was not verified, not that a feature or course is unavailable. Figures and specifications may change by country, variant and date. Always confirm on the [source page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xiaomi_Mi_3) before applying or buying. Published as a reference guide on 2026-11-06, not as breaking news.

## जरूरी जाँच

निर्माता के दस्तावेजों से सही क्षेत्रीय मॉडल, चिपसेट, स्क्रीन, बैटरी, चार्जिंग, कैमरा, स्टोरेज, नेटवर्क बैंड और सॉफ्टवेयर अपडेट की जानकारी मिलाएँ।

कीमत बाजार, स्टोरेज, टैक्स और तारीख के अनुसार बदलती है। मौजूदा कीमत, वारंटी और उपलब्धता निर्माता या अधिकृत विक्रेता से जाँचें।

खरीदने से पहले स्थानीय वारंटी, नेटवर्क सपोर्ट, वापसी नीति, अपडेट, एक्सेसरीज और मरम्मत की उपलब्धता जाँचें।
